title: Repository
description: A raw GitHub repository observation mapped into the canonical estate. Repositories are the source material; systems are the real portfolio. Each inspection of a repository should update this object and potentially trigger changes to the system, capability, and evidence graphs.

system_id.description: The canonical system this repo primarily realizes. FK → system.schema.json

lineage_id.description: FK → lineage.schema.json. The family this repo belongs to.

role.description: primary = canonical implementation of system_id. Only one repo per system should be primary at any time.

github.description: Snapshot of GitHub metadata at last inspection. Not authoritative — always re-fetch before acting.

inspection_state.description: Tracks the engine's knowledge of this repo at a specific point in time

head_sha.description: Commit SHA at time of last inspection. All file:line refs must be anchored here.

stale_after_days.description: Days before inspection_state is considered stale and re-inspection is triggered

active_bottleneck_id.description: The single highest-priority bottleneck the engine is currently targeting in this repo

capabilities_claimed.description: capability_ids this repo claims to implement (from README, code, or agent inspection). Unverified until evidence exists.

capabilities_proven.description: capability_ids with at least one VERIFIED evidence object. Computed by estate engine.

evidence_ids.description: All claim_ids produced from this repository

value_score.description: Computed by estate engine. Combination of capability density, evidence quality, and system priority. Drives target selection.

technical_debt_signals.description: Known debt items that reduce value_score. e.g. no tests, no CI, stale deps
